question: Measure DAFpay and other DAF options inside donation forms that open only on interaction (Classy/GoFundMe Pro, Blackbaud Luminate, Fundraise Up modal steps) for the same ~300 top DAF recipients, by reading each platform's public per-campaign configuration (e.g. the payment-methods list served to the form) where robots.txt allows, without clicking or submitting. Report how many of the 30 Classy and 20 Fundraise Up pages actually enable a DAF method
conclusion_affected: Share of top DAF-grant recipients that accept a DAF grant inside checkout (currently 13% confirmed DAFpay on donate pages); whether Chariot's reach is mostly via platform defaults
rationale: The rendered-page scan confirms DAFpay on 25 of 186 donate pages (20 with the Chariot script loaded). Five more pages carry only platform-generic DAFpay strings (Classy i18n label, Fundraise Up CSS class) and were not counted. Classy pages showed confirmed DAFpay on 4 of 30 and Fundraise Up on 7 of 20, so platform enablement is the open question

question: Recover the 89 of 300 charities whose donate page could not be scanned (21 robots.txt unreadable, 23 homepage 403/405/bot challenge, 12 donate page disallowed by robots, 10 donate page unreachable, 28 with no donate link, 17 no website) by using first-party alternatives that robots permit (a sitemap-listed giving page, a /ways-to-give page, or the charity's own DAF instructions page), and test whether the scanned 186 are representative of the 300 by DAF dollars
conclusion_affected: Robustness of the adoption rates; universities are under-covered (9 of the 23 DAFRC university/hospital EINs had no scannable donate page)
rationale: Education (86 of 300 charities; 53 scanned) shows among the lowest rates (26% any DAF option); 9 university giving sites disallow their gift forms in robots.txt. The scanned 186 hold $12.67bn of the sample's $24.08bn DAF dollars (53%)

question: Profile the 'pass-through' recipients that take large DAF grants but have no public donate page (fiscal sponsors and intermediaries such as New Venture Fund, Hopewell, Windward, Blue Meridian, ClimateWorks, Energy Foundation): how they receive DAF grants (sponsor grant portal only, wire instructions, grant agreements) and what share of top-50 DAF dollars they take
conclusion_affected: Whether a DAF entrant's charity-side checkout matters for the largest DAF dollars, or whether those flow by sponsor-initiated grants to intermediaries that never use a donate page
rationale: 28 of the 300 largest DAF recipients had a reachable homepage but no donate or give link; most are fiscal sponsors, regranting intermediaries or research institutes, and several are in the top 30 by DAF dollars (New Venture Fund $0.43bn, Blue Meridian $0.36bn, Climate Imperative $0.25bn)
